messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired for service=dedicated-reserved-agent, severity=critical. Trigger: tenant_stellarpay_reserved_pool_io_high (5m breach)
pagerduty: INCIDENT: P123456 - Reserved capacity IO saturation - tenant=StellarPay - triggered at 2026-03-14T09:13:09Z
oncall-sre: acked pagerduty P123456 :thumbsup: I'm on it, pulling metrics now
sam: I see io_wait and qdepth spikes on the reserved pool for cluster-rdwn-12, tenant id stlr-89 
jia: confirming, KV cache eviction rates up ~8x in last 10m, tail latencies > 200ms for small inference requests
miguel: pushing a quick dashboard: https://grafana.internal/r/cluster-rdwn-12?from=now-30m to everyone
liz: @oncall-sre any immediate mitigations? can we move StellarPay to burst fallback or scale reserved pool?
oncall-sre: trying soft-failover to burst tier for new requests, patching routing policy now -> running command:
```
redwoodctl route update --tenant stlr-89 --policy fallback:burst --dry-run=false
```

pagerduty: NOTE: escalation policy will alert SRE leads at +5m if unacked/active
sam: attempted bump to +2 instances in reserved pool, autoscaler returned throttled due to node quota in region-us-west2
miguel: quota hit. Opening quick infra ticket for quota increase with cloud: CHG-7892
jia: temp workaround: enable prefix KV cache pinning for stlr-89 to reduce full-cache misses. Applying config:
```
services/stlr-89/kv_cache_override: enabled=true, pin_prefixes=["/customer/stlr-89/predict/"]
```

oncall-sre: applied pinning. Observed immediate drop in eviction rate within ~40s, latency starting to improve
liz: customer-success-bot, do we need to notify StellarPay about degraded performance & mitigation steps?
customer-success-bot: Drafted note: "We detected transient elevated latency for your dedicated pool earlier. Our team applied mitigation and is monitoring; we will follow up with root cause and timeline." Approve to send?
kevin: +1 to notify, keep it high level. No config details. cc account team
oncall-sre: paging infra: request quota increase expedited, but ETA ~20-30m. We should plan a handoff in 25m if still active
sam: tail error traces show some GPU host IO threads stuck due to background snapshots. Investigating which hosts. Running:
```
ssh mgmt@node-rdwn-12-07 "sudo journalctl -u snapshot-agent -n 200"
```

miguel: snapshot-agent spike confirmed on node-rdwn-12-07 and -12-09, both handling stlr-89 shards. I can try killing snapshot-agent on those nodes to clear IO backlog, but that's risky mid-production
jia: do it with cordon + drain of affected shard first, then bring agent back after snapshot completes
oncall-sre: proceeding with careful kill+restart on 12-07, cordon in place. Will monitor for improved iowait
liz: good call. Keep all changes logged in incident timeline doc: https://confluence.internal/incident/P123456

oncall-sre: snapshot-agent restart on node-rdwn-12-07 done. iowait dropped ~65% in 2m, request lat p50 from 180ms -> 85ms
sam: -09 still noisy, scheduling restart there in 2m window
miguel: started restart on -09, taking shard offline briefly, traffic redirected to healthy nodes by routing

pagerduty: Update: Incident P123456 acknowledged by oncall-sre at 2026-03-14T09:14:05Z. Escalation paused.

oncall-sre: monitoring. KV pin + snapshot restarts reduced errors and latencies. No new throttles reported in reserved pool logs for last 4m
jia: recommend keeping KV pin for 12h and schedule snapshot-agent config tweak to avoid concurrent snapshots for dedicated pools. Filing follow-up: INT-4521
n oncall-sre: Planning handoff to next oncall @ 09:40 UTC. Current status: degraded->stabilized; mitigations applied; infra quota increase pending. If anything reappears, escalate to SRE leads and infra.

liz: note for followup meeting: confirm whether snapshot scheduling change is safe across clusters and plan maintenance window

customer-success-bot: Sent notification to StellarPay account contact summarizing incident and mitigation at 2026-03-14T09:23:05Z
kevin: +1. Good rapid response. Marking incident as "mitigated" for customer update; keep open until quota bump and config tweak are complete.

oncall-sre: adding timeline note and closing this active pager. Will handoff with details to @jia for RCA ownership.

pagerduty: INCIDENT: P123456 status changed to mitigated at 2026-03-14T09:26:50Z"
